runs.question: Which four functions make up the NIST AI RMF Core, and which one is described as cross-cutting?

answer.text: The AI RMF Core is built on four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. The AI RMF Core provides outcomes and actions that enable dialogue, understanding, and activities to manage AI risks and responsibly develop trustworthy AI systems. GOVERN is the function described as cross-cutting. It is meant to run through the other three, so that they draw on its direction. Risk management should be continuous, timely, and performed throughout the AI system lifecycle dimensions.
